title: SB0406 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-24; crossfiled twin https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB0120.pdf is the same printed document (it names SENATE BILL 406); copied from TN-HB-120-2023.draft.txt)
provenance.note: Draft of 2023-01-24 (as introduced); amendments not in text. Both sections are word swaps (handgun -> firearm). Twin: TN-HB-120-2023 shares this document.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)): is amended by deleting the language "handgun" wherever it appears and substituting the language "firearm".
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1313(a)): is amended by deleting the language "lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to" and substituting the language "lawfully carries a firearm pursuant to".
